events.text: Hana: I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I say yes—what exactly is needed for the repair drive?
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Mara: We’re collecting basic repair supplies like tape, screws, glue, and a few small tools so folks can fix up broken things at home. If you want, I can send the full list and drop-off details.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Hana: Yes, please send the full list and drop-off details so I can double-check everything before I decide.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Jules: I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive—who should I check in with first?
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Mara: Start with the block captains on Maple and Pine—they’ve been helping us coordinate. I’ll send you the flyer details right after this.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Jules: Great, I’ll check in with the Maple and Pine block captains first and keep an eye out for your flyer details.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Cleo: I’m checking our supplies now, Mara, and I’ll tell you what we’re short on. Once I’ve got the list, I can point folks to the first repair job.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Mara: Thanks, Cleo — send me the short list when you’re ready, and I’ll help point people to the first repair job.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Cleo: Will do — I’ll finish the supply check and send you the short list shortly.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mara — I can lend a hand and bring over any tools we need for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Mara: That’s wonderful, Gus — we’re collecting basics like tape, screws, glue, and a few small tools. I’ll send you the full list and drop-off details right after this.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Gus: Sounds good, Mara — send the list when you’re ready, and I’ll round up what I can. Happy to help get the repair drive set up.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Tess: Yep, last I heard it’s down to just a few odds and ends. I’ll keep my ears open and let you know if anything major comes up.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — that helps. If anything major changes, just let me know and I’ll keep the repair drive details up to date.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Tess: Will do, Mara — I’ll pass along anything new if I hear it.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Pia: That should work — just send me the timing and a clear drop-off spot, and I can take a few as long as they’re labeled.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll send the timing and the drop-off spot, plus a labeled list so it’s easy to sort. Thanks, Pia, that really helps.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Pia: Sounds good — once you send that over, I can take a few and keep it manageable.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Bo: That works — I’ll start with Mara and the block captains, then ask folks to jot down what needs fixing when they stop by.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Mara: Perfect — that’ll help us get organized. I’ll send you the full supply list and drop-off details so you can share them with the block captains.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Bo: Great — send me the supply list and drop-off details, and I’ll pass them along to Mara and the block captains.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Leo: Thanks, Mara — please confirm the pickup timing when you can. I’ll plan around 3:30 to 5:30 for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Mara: That timing works — I’ll confirm the pickup window and keep it set for 3:30 to 5:30. I’ll let you know right away if anything changes.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Leo: Sounds good, Mara — thanks. Please keep me posted if the pickup window shifts.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mara — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — we’re collecting basics like tape, screws, glue, and a few small tools. I’ll send you the full list and drop-off details right after this.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Gus: Sounds good, Mara — send the list and drop-off details when you can, and I’ll round up what I have.
events.speaker: Gus
